title: diini footimah addat tan maxhax
intro: Atu tibba le diini arac fan cullateh Yallih taama abeyna salaatah soolak table. ken gaba fayya inte, ken intiita fayya inte, kee ken sorkocobaxi quukah maxhax mano waktil. iyyaay ta nabsi sabri Yallal kibal kak obsime wayta?
clues: Anu mango sanoota qibaadah kee dooqat tatruse, yi imaan maqarrosseh tan muqjizat sumaqtah.
anu masquuliyat yomcowweh barkat le qunxa rooci dacrisuh diini aracal.
Anu idaalite wak, yok kaxxa rooka baxa alle waamih taagah, yi barra xalay luk sugteeh, nanu nammayak inkih karmat sugne.
Anu inni buxah marak ciggiila numuy, nabiyyih naggaarinni quukah yan numuh yi Rabbih dooqa abe.
Anu salat aracal soolak suge waqdi, malayka yoo seecak, Yalli rufto koh yaceeh, anu kaadu bohoy kee bohoy luk suge.
Anu Yahya deqsita baxa alleyyom warseenih, dumah numuh akah yeceen migaq, kee astah sidiica ayroh sinam luk yaabam maduuda.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
